## 主张 Claim

给定市场规律、有效保护证书、安全初态及逐步容许扰动，原实际守卫在所有自然数时刻都与运行历史一致，不发生支持失败。 / Given the market law, a valid protection certificate, a safe initial state and admissible disturbances at every step, the actual guarded history agrees with the operating history at every natural time without support failure.

Canonical source: [MarketGenerativity.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/MarketGenerativity.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- Certificate、Safe、Admissible 的全部公开条件，包括选择、责任、影响、资金及各支持底线；不是只检查维护份额。 / All public Certificate, Safe and Admissible conditions, including selection, accountability, influence, funding and every support floor; renewal share alone is insufficient.

量表示指定市场中的运行关系与支持，必要支持由 essential 指定；其正确性、伦理范围和真实参数另需对应。 / Quantities represent the specified market relations and supports; essential designates necessary supports. Correct mapping, ethical scope and actual parameters remain separate.
